title: Calcite chapel of Amenhotep I
summary: The reconstructed chapel preserves early depictions of Amun’s sacred bark.
orientation: Reconstructed in the Open Air Museum; ancient position disputed.

claims.text: The reconstructed chapel preserves early depictions of Amun’s sacred bark.
Doorways on its short sides could be closed with wooden doors.
